test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Given here are four sentences. The first sentence is in correct order, while the rest of the sentences are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. The Brahman used to teach pupils from time to time.

B. This young man knew that the Brahmin was in possession of a certain spell.

C. He had one pupil of whom he thought very highly.

D. But he didn’t know what the spell could do.
solution:
The correct answer is "ACBD"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement A is the opening sentence of the passage which explains that **The Brahman occasionally gave lessons to students.**
 
• Statement C is the second sentence of the passage which explains that **He had a student that he held in the highest regard.**
 
• Statement B is the third sentence of the passage which explains **This young man was aware that the Brahmin possessed a certain spell.**
 
• Statement D is the last sentence of the passage which shows that **But he was unaware of the power of the spell.**

Hence, the correct sequence is A, C, B, D

The correct answer is option 3.

The correct passage is: ***A**. The Brahman used to teach pupils from time to time. **C**. He had one pupil of whom he thought very highly. **B**. This young man knew that the Brahmin was in possession of a certain spell. **D**. But he didn’t know what the spell could do.*
